transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support, my name is George. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi George. I turned on our TV box this morning after an automated software update rebooted overnight, and every single one of our recorded programs has completely vanished! Ten years of family recordings, weddings, and documentaries are completely gone!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how distressing it is to find your recorded library missing after a system update, Scarlett. Let's look into your TV box account immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you George, because my children are heartbroken about their school theater plays being missing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we access the set-top box configuration, could you please verify your installation address and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the address is 5 St Andrews Court, Edinburgh, EH1 2TX, my contact mobile is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero four five one, and the security PIN is 7703.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for verifying those details, Scarlett. I have your TV 360 subscription loaded onto our portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So just to make sure I understand what has happened: following yesterday's automated cloud firmware migration, all previously recorded television programs and stored home video media on your TV box have disappeared from your saved recordings list. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly that. When I press the recordings button on the remote, the list says 'Zero recordings available, your cloud library is empty'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our television platform underwent a nationwide cloud firmware migration yesterday, transitioning legacy V6 hard disk storage to centralized cloud DVR servers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the cloud migration wipe the internal hard drive inside the box?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new TV 360 operating system formats local mechanical hard drives to initialize cloud streaming caching.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Without warning customers that all their saved content would be deleted?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Automated email advisory notices were dispatched to primary billing account email addresses thirty days prior to migration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I never received any email about recordings being deleted! I check my inbox every single morning!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Notification emails were transmitted to the primary contact address on file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Those recordings included my late father's seventieth birthday celebration, our wedding anniversary video transferred from camcorder tapes, and eight years of Christmas morning family traditions!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please bear with me on hold for about thirty-five seconds while I query the central cloud synchronization database ledger to check whether any metadata was archived.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Scarlett. The cloud ledger confirms the local storage partition was completely wiped and initialized during the automated firmware upgrade.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can your technical engineering team restore the wiped partition from a system backup image or run a block-level data recovery utility?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Local magnetic hard drive formats perform a low-level sector erase that overwrites file allocation tables, which cannot be reversed by our server systems.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So those irreplaceable personal family videos and memories are permanently gone forever with zero chance of recovery?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There is zero recovery mechanism for locally stored media once the cloud DVR partition initializes across customer set-top boxes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We kept those recordings on that box for eight years because your sales agents explicitly assured us that the physical box had a one-terabyte permanent hard drive for permanent domestic storage!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, using a cable set-top box as a permanent family archive instead of backing up your home movies to an external hard drive is pretty foolish, Scarlett.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Excuse me?! Calling a paying customer foolish when your automated update just wiped out eight years of family memories without permission is utterly disgraceful!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize if that phrasing came across as blunt or offensive, Scarlett. I was attempting to point out that consumer broadcast set-top boxes are primarily designed as temporary entertainment receivers rather than secure archival storage media.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have no right to speak to customers in that condescending manner when our equipment contract promised permanent hard drive space!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me explain how the new Cloud DVR functionality operates going forward.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't care about new features when my old recordings are gone!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under the new cloud platform, you receive five hundred hours of dedicated cloud storage that never degrades from disk failure and can be accessed seamlessly from any mobile tablet, laptop, or smartphone.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can cloud recordings be accidentally deleted by future firmware updates?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Cloud recordings are stored across redundant data centers with automated multi-region replication, eliminating local hardware failure risks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would have been useful eight years ago before my father's videos were erased.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can also set series links that automatically record upcoming broadcast episodes across all major UK channels.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will our planned scheduled recordings still record tonight?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, all prime-time broadcast series links have been migrated to cloud scheduling automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: At least we won't miss tonight's drama series finale.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can pause and rewind live television on any channel with up to sixty minutes of instant buffer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Live pause is helpful when answering the door.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm what you mentioned earlier, Scarlett, your contact mobile number on file is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero four five one?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero four five one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have verified your mobile number for automated TV platform service notifications.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will keep me updated on future platform changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I pay ninety pounds every month for full TV Max and broadband, and your automated update wipes out all our irreplaceable family memories and you call me foolish?! This is the worst, most insulting customer service I have ever experienced in my entire life!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Cloud migration terms and conditions explicitly state that cloud storage does not guarantee permanent archival retention of third-party media.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hiding behind legal terms and conditions after insulting a customer is cowardly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will apply a thirty-pound goodwill credit to your billing profile to compensate for the distress caused.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thirty pounds doesn't replace my father's birthday video, but at least you are admitting fault.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The thirty-pound credit will be deducted from your upcoming direct debit bill in November.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will my monthly subscription price remain the same under the new cloud contract?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, your contract tier, promotional discounts, and monthly rate of ninety pounds remain completely unchanged.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is good so there are no unexpected price increases.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: How is your broadband and landline performance working alongside the television service?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Broadband and landline have been working reliably with good download speeds, so internet has been fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am very pleased to hear your broadband connection remains strong and consistent.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It was strictly the unexpected loss of our TV recordings that caused such upset.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The customer goodwill reference number logged on your file is TV-88190-C.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Noted down... TV-88190-C.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have verified that the thirty-pound goodwill credit is applied, your cloud DVR profile is fully active with five hundred hours capacity across your TV boxes, and your scheduled prime-time series links are locked. Does that address all remaining operational questions today, Scarlett?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes George, you've explained the cloud system and applied the credit. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net today, Scarlett. Have a pleasant evening. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye George.
